{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Ducky''' was the first enemy appeareds in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has medium health and average speed. The '''Ducky''' can be spawned by [[Eggroll 1]], [[Eggroll 2]] and [[Eggroll 3]]. ==Logbook Description== "''A new duckling filled with gentle quacks and boundless possibilities. Could they become an Agent? A Pilot? A Spy? The road ahead is bright with few obstacles in their path. With determination in their heart and curiosity in their eyes, they waddle forward into countless adventures. The future holds endless potential!''" ==Appearance== The '''Ducky''' is a normal, yellow duck with an orange beak and orange flippers. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Ducky''' itself is quite weak, though it generally spawns in high numbers. **Area of effect towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]] are effective at clearing them out. **Single target DPS towers can also be useful here, such towers include the [[Cowboy]], [[Engineer]] or [[Ace Pilot]]. *Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] can deal with it quite easily. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} DuckyDeath.gif|Current death animation (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Ducky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Ducky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1Ducky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckyD00M3Thumbnail2.png|'''Ducky''' on the game thumbnail. TheHuntDuck.png|'''Ducky''' behind the portal in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event|The Hunt: Mega Edition]] event }} ==Trivia== *The '''Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Ducky''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Ducky''' clips into the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''28 May 2025''' - [[v1.65.0]] **'''Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 April 2026''' - [[v1.88.0]] **'''Ducky''' re-added to the main game, now appears in [[Bathroom Approach]]. **Health decreased from 6 to 4 in Easy difficulty. **Speed increased from Average (3) to Above Average (3.5). **Cash given increased from {{Money|8}} to {{Money|16}} on death in Easy difficulty. **Cash given increased from {{Money|10}} to {{Money|16}} on death in Hard difficulty. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer clips into the ground when made larger or smaller. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Ducky''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{BathroomApproach|Start|N/A|Ducky|Wave 1|[[Cool Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Cool Ducky]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Ducky}}
